dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with high-contrast white perimeters and darker centers. The edges are irregular and undulating, showing a sharp transition from the dark base coat to the high-intensity ring, with subtle internal gradients within the rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge and anterior-lateral sections, appearing as solid pixel groups without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli in the mid-lateral region form an obtuse, scalene triangle. A series of smaller blobs in the anterior region form a roughly linear, downward-sloping trajectory relative to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, interlocking reticulated network where several macro-annuli merge to create a chain-like or maze-like pattern along the posterior-lateral flank.
